id, workspace_id, record_type, status, position, revision, current_version_id, created_by_id, updated_by_id, archived_at, created_at, updated_at
id, workspace_id, template_id, version_number, name_en, name_ja, description_en, description_ja, definition_json, definition_hash, created_by_id, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO record_creation_template_set (workspace_id, record_type) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{recordType})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM record_creation_template_set WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND record_type = #{recordType} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM record_creation_template WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND record_type = #{recordType} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM record_creation_template WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{templateId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT v.id, v.workspace_id, v.template_id, v.version_number, v.name_en, v.name_ja, v.description_en, v.description_ja, v.definition_json, v.definition_hash, v.created_by_id, v.created_at FROM record_creation_template t JOIN record_creation_template_version v ON v.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND v.template_id = t.id AND v.id = t.current_version_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.id = #{templateId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO record_creation_template (workspace_id, record_type, status, position, revision, current_version_id, created_by_id, updated_by_id, archived_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{recordType}, #{status}, #{position}, #{revision}, #{currentVersionId}, #{createdById}, #{updatedById}, #{archivedAt})

INSERT INTO record_creation_template_version (workspace_id, template_id, version_number, name_en, name_ja, description_en, description_ja, definition_json, definition_hash, created_by_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{templateId}, #{versionNumber}, #{nameEn}, #{nameJa}, #{descriptionEn}, #{descriptionJa}, #{definitionJson}, #{definitionHash}, #{createdById})
